notes.judge: w8_envscout.maze_colour.judge, re-exported unwrapped as w9_harness.judge_maze.JUDGE.  Four-part audit (source/types/redundant-replay/oracle) passes; see judge_audit in each seed report.
notes.encoder: one conv autoencoder per seed, trained by per-pixel reconstruction on maze images only, then FROZEN.  No arm objective reaches it; every arm reads the same features.
notes.action_head: one ActionHead class, d_model fixed at 32 for every arm and built from a single shared PRNG key, so all heads start byte-identical and have identical shape.  Weights are then trained per arm -- that part is NOT shared and is stated as such.
notes.columns: fragment-lookup and composition-blind are REPORTED COLUMNS.  Nothing in this harness aborts or filters on them.
notes.CAVEAT_refuser: READ THIS BEFORE USING A DISPLAY ROW.  The refuser does NOT separate possible from impossible: separation (refusal on impossible minus refusal on possible) is +0.047 [0.000, 0.115] over 3 seeds on cmaze1 and +0.020 [-0.005, 0.050] on cmaze1-easy.  A ridge probe on the same shared observation at t=0 gets AUC 0.48-0.55 for possible-vs-impossible, i.e. chance, so this is a property of the PROBLEM at this scale (deciding solvability within a budget is close to solving the maze), not of the wiring.  DISPLAY-row comparisons against this refuser are not yet informative.  See refusal_separability.json.
notes.CAVEAT_encoder_instability: The seed sweep was run BEFORE the encoder restart fix.  A single 1200-step encoder run is unreliable: seed 1 stalled at BCE 0.0796 (probe AUC 0.61) where seeds 0/2 reached 0.0050/0.0038 (AUC 0.92/0.80), so seed 1's arm numbers inherit a degraded encoder.  encoder.train now takes restarts / accept_bce, selected on RECONSTRUCTION LOSS ONLY; verified across all 6 seed x tier combinations, worst-case BCE 0.101 -> 0.010 and worst-case mean probe AUC 0.44 -> 0.75, at no extra cost.  See encoder_probe_1restart.json vs encoder_probe_restarts.json.  Re-running the arm sweep with the fixed encoder is DECLARED NOT-RUN (wall clock).
notes.CAVEAT_learned_arms: Under a zero-tolerance judge the learned arms are near the floor: validity 0.000-0.005 (cmaze1) and 0.015-0.018 (cmaze1-easy) against an oracle of 1.0 and a strongest-blind-planner column of 0.53 / 0.80.  Teacher-forced per-step accuracy (0.52 MLP / 0.75 LSTM / 0.74 transformer) and the exact diagnostics are where the dynamic range is at this training budget.
notes.refuser: supervised transformer with a REFUSE token, trained on exactly-certified impossible instances.  It is the only comparator for DISPLAY rows.  No impossible instance appears in any other arm's data.

easy_tier.note: CMAZE-1-EASY: same generator (h=w=4, k=2), same exact judge, declared separately and never averaged with the main tier.
